Flight Academy

Learn to fly, one skill at a time

Fourteen short lessons in the sim. $150 each.

0/14lessons complete
01

Lesson 1 · Ground school

Set up your controls

Most "the plane has a mind of its own" problems are controller setup: a stick that isn't centered, two devices fighting over one axis, or no dead zone.

10 min
02

Lesson 2 · Beginner

Engine start and taxi

Taxiing is where the flight starts.

10 min
03

Lesson 3 · Beginner

Your first takeoff

A good takeoff is smooth and boring: full power, straight down the centerline, lift off at the right speed, climb at the best rate.

10 min
04

Lesson 4 · Beginner

Straight, level and trimmed

Trim takes the pressure off the controls so the plane flies itself.

10 min
05

Lesson 5 · Beginner

Turns without losing altitude

In a turn, part of the wing's lift tilts sideways, so the nose wants to drop.

10 min
06

Lesson 6 · Beginner

Mixture: what the co-pilot keeps telling you

Air gets thinner as you climb.

8 min
07

Lesson 7 · Intermediate

Flaps and speed limits

Flaps let you fly slower and descend steeper, but they have speed limits.

10 min
08

Lesson 8 · Intermediate

Slow flight and stalls

A stall isn't the engine stopping.

12 min
09

Lesson 9 · Intermediate

Fly the traffic pattern

The pattern is a rectangle around the runway that every pilot flies the same way, so everyone knows where everyone else is.

15 min
10

Lesson 10 · Intermediate

The landing

Good landings come from good approaches.

15 min
11

Lesson 11 · Advanced

Crosswind landing

The trade winds don't always blow straight down the runway.

15 min
12

Lesson 12 · Advanced

Autopilot basics

Autopilot is a tool for managing workload, not a replacement for flying.

8 min
13

Lesson 13 · Advanced

Talking to ATC in MSFS

MSFS's built-in ATC teaches the rhythm of real radio calls.

10 min
14

Lesson 14 · Real world

From sim to sky: becoming a pilot

Everything you just practiced is real.

state:early/hangar:msfs:
Live MSFS connection

Live sim off

The MSFS Bridge is a small program on your PC that reads MSFS 2020 or 2024 through SimConnect and hands this page your position, fuel and an automatic flight recording: block out, takeoff, touchdown rate, landing spot and block in. The debrief fills itself in from it.

  1. Install Node.js (LTS) if you don't have it.
  2. Unzip the msfs-bridge folder somewhere permanent, for example C:\Users\you\msfs-bridge, and double-click install.bat.
  3. In the Claude desktop app: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, and add the msfs-bridge entry from the README. Restart the Claude app.
  4. Open this page in the Claude desktop app on the same PC, start MSFS, and load into a flight.

It only works in the Claude desktop app on the PC running MSFS. In a browser or on your phone the career still works; you just log landings by hand.

state:midstory/hangar:msfs:
Live MSFS connection

Live sim off

The MSFS Bridge is a small program on your PC that reads MSFS 2020 or 2024 through SimConnect and hands this page your position, fuel and an automatic flight recording: block out, takeoff, touchdown rate, landing spot and block in. The debrief fills itself in from it.

  1. Install Node.js (LTS) if you don't have it.
  2. Unzip the msfs-bridge folder somewhere permanent, for example C:\Users\you\msfs-bridge, and double-click install.bat.
  3. In the Claude desktop app: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, and add the msfs-bridge entry from the README. Restart the Claude app.
  4. Open this page in the Claude desktop app on the same PC, start MSFS, and load into a flight.

It only works in the Claude desktop app on the PC running MSFS. In a browser or on your phone the career still works; you just log landings by hand.

  1. Act 1 · Clean Hands

    The Extra Box

    You flew Dez's unlabeled box to Anguilla. A man in a white pickup took it without a word, and Dez paid you $200 cash.

    You opened the bag on the way to Nevis: $400,000 in hundreds. You delivered it anyway.

    Customs met you at Juliana. Dez swapped the coolers before they reached the plane. Now you and Dez are in this together.

  8. 6
    The Passengers

    You flew four people with no papers to Tortola. One of them was a boy who couldn't breathe.

  9. 7
    The Files

    You flew Castillo's lawyer and his hard drive out of Tortola. Two days later he was found in the harbor.

  10. 8

state:feds/hangar:msfs:
Live MSFS connection

Live sim off

The MSFS Bridge is a small program on your PC that reads MSFS 2020 or 2024 through SimConnect and hands this page your position, fuel and an automatic flight recording: block out, takeoff, touchdown rate, landing spot and block in. The debrief fills itself in from it.

  1. Install Node.js (LTS) if you don't have it.
  2. Unzip the msfs-bridge folder somewhere permanent, for example C:\Users\you\msfs-bridge, and double-click install.bat.
  3. In the Claude desktop app: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, and add the msfs-bridge entry from the README. Restart the Claude app.
  4. Open this page in the Claude desktop app on the same PC, start MSFS, and load into a flight.

It only works in the Claude desktop app on the PC running MSFS. In a browser or on your phone the career still works; you just log landings by hand.

Live sim off

The MSFS Bridge is a small program on your PC that reads MSFS 2020 or 2024 through SimConnect and hands this page your position, fuel and an automatic flight recording: block out, takeoff, touchdown rate, landing spot and block in. The debrief fills itself in from it.

  1. Install Node.js (LTS) if you don't have it.
  2. Unzip the msfs-bridge folder somewhere permanent, for example C:\Users\you\msfs-bridge, and double-click install.bat.
  3. In the Claude desktop app: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, and add the msfs-bridge entry from the README. Restart the Claude app.
  4. Open this page in the Claude desktop app on the same PC, start MSFS, and load into a flight.

It only works in the Claude desktop app on the PC running MSFS. In a browser or on your phone the career still works; you just log landings by hand.

What this flight teaches

  • Anguilla is about 10 nm north of Juliana. Climb to 2,500 ft and you'll see it straight ahead.
  • Expect runway 11 at TQPF: about 13 kt of headwind and 0 kt of crosswind. The Cessna 172 Skyhawk G1000's demonstrated crosswind is around 15 kt.
  • Density altitude at TNCM is about 1,576 ft at 29 °C. The airplane performs as if the airport were that high, so expect a longer takeoff roll and a weaker climb.
  • International flight: Sint Maarten (NL) to Anguilla (UK). File a flight plan, carry your passport and the passengers' details, and clear customs and immigration on arrival.
  • First flight in the Cessna 172 Skyhawk G1000. Forgiving, slow and dependable. The backbone of island hopping. Speeds: Vr 55 · Vy 74 · Cruise 115 · Approach 65 KIAS.
  • Read the METAR: wind 110° at 13 kt; visibility 10+ miles; few clouds at 2,500 ft, scattered clouds at 3,500 ft; 29 °C.

Briefing

Whatever the ferry couldn't take this week.

Benjamín Rivera Noriega has 2,600 ft of runway. Touch down in the first third and you'll stop with room to spare.

Flight details: conditions, weights, route, aircraft and passengers

What this flight teaches

  • Expect runway 13 at TJCP: about 11 kt of headwind and 10 kt of crosswind. The Zlin Savage Cub's demonstrated crosswind is around 12 kt.
  • Density altitude at TNCE is about 1,960 ft at 30 °C. The airplane performs as if the airport were that high, so expect a longer takeoff roll and a weaker climb.
  • International flight: Caribbean Netherlands to Puerto Rico (US). File a flight plan, carry your passport and the passengers' details, and clear customs and immigration on arrival.
  • Arriving in US airspace: altimeter settings are in inches of mercury and visibility in statute miles.
  • Night flight. Over water at night there's no horizon, so trust your attitude indicator and fly a stabilized approach to a lit runway.
  • First flight in the Zlin Savage Cub. Light backcountry taildragger. A feather in gusts, so fly it with your feet. Speeds: Lift-off ~38 · Cruise 85 · Approach 45 KIAS.

Client briefing

Briefing

Whatever the ferry couldn't take this week.

Benjamín Rivera Noriega has 2,600 ft of runway. Touch down in the first third and you'll stop with room to spare.

Flight details: conditions, weights, route, aircraft and passengers

What this flight teaches

  • Expect runway 13 at TJCP: about 11 kt of headwind and 10 kt of crosswind. The Zlin Savage Cub's demonstrated crosswind is around 12 kt.
  • Density altitude at TNCE is about 1,960 ft at 30 °C. The airplane performs as if the airport were that high, so expect a longer takeoff roll and a weaker climb.
  • International flight: Caribbean Netherlands to Puerto Rico (US). File a flight plan, carry your passport and the passengers' details, and clear customs and immigration on arrival.
  • Arriving in US airspace: altimeter settings are in inches of mercury and visibility in statute miles.
  • Night flight. Over water at night there's no horizon, so trust your attitude indicator and fly a stabilized approach to a lit runway.
  • First flight in the Zlin Savage Cub. Light backcountry taildragger. A feather in gusts, so fly it with your feet. Speeds: Lift-off ~38 · Cruise 85 · Approach 45 KIAS.

Conditions

Saharan dust hazeMVFR

African dust drifted across the Atlantic. The sky turns milky and visibility drops, which makes distances over water hard to judge.

Client briefing

Briefing

A wedding party flew to St. Croix, and their suitcases flew somewhere else. The bags turned up on Sint Eustatius this morning, including, everyone hopes, the dress.

The wedding is tomorrow at noon. Get the bags there today and the bride's mother may stop calling the airline.

Flight details: conditions, weights, route, aircraft and passengers

What this flight teaches

  • Expect runway 10 at TISX: about 17 kt of headwind and 3 kt of crosswind. The Diamond DA62's demonstrated crosswind is around 25 kt.
  • Density altitude at TNCE is about 1,720 ft at 28 °C. The airplane performs as if the airport were that high, so expect a longer takeoff roll and a weaker climb.
  • International flight: Caribbean Netherlands to US Virgin Islands. File a flight plan, carry your passport and the passengers' details, and clear customs and immigration on arrival.
  • Arriving in US airspace: altimeter settings are in inches of mercury and visibility in statute miles.
  • First flight in the Diamond DA62. Modern diesel twin and your multi-engine classroom. Learn "dead foot, dead engine" here. Speeds: Vr 76 · Vmc 76 · Vyse 92 · Cruise 170 · Approach 85 KIAS.
  • Read the METAR: wind 090° at 17 kt; visibility 10+ miles; few clouds at 2,500 ft, scattered clouds at 3,500 ft; 28 °C.
